title: Efficient Ammonia Synthesis over a Core-shell Ru/CeO2 Catalyst with Tunable CeO2 Size: DFT Calculation and XAS Spectroscopy Studies
extraction_notes: No SI figures contain plotted catalytic-performance data for thermal NH3 synthesis (rate, outlet NH3 concentration, or TOF). Figures S1-S7 are SEM/TEM/Raman/UV-vis/H2-TPR/SEM/XPS/DRIFTS characterisation. The mass-transfer section includes a text calculation using a reaction rate, but it is not a plotted SI figure data point and was therefore not extracted.
